Tiebreaker Scenarios

[edit]

In-order of:

  • 1. First place finishes, if tied, Second places are then considered and so-on if tied
  • 2. More Points from direct matches against the tied club
  • 3. If unable to break the tie, other methods maybe considered by the administration
    • Tiebreaker will not be used if it does not involved 1st place in the Club standings, on this case the prize money will be split evenly
